main_text.p: Flagellum inundans, Jes.28.15. id est, Plaga erumpentis torrentis instar terram pervadens, R. Salomon. Scribitur autem cum ', sed juxta Masorethas legendum per Vau: שוט לסוס Flagellum equo, Prov.26.3. בשוט vide in principio Radicis: Plural. יסר אתכם בשוטים Castigavit vos scuticis, 1.Reg.12.11.

שט m. Remex, qui remos agit. Plur. היו שטים לך Fuerunt remiges tibi, Ezech.27.8. השטים אותך Remiges tui, verf.26. Kimchi in lib.Rad. vult אותך idem hic esse quod antea לך, pro, Remiges tibi, id est; Remiges tui. In Commentar. exponit שאטים [?] Depradantes, quomodo & Chaldaus explicat. Quidam volunt esse Particip. Kal, Remis agentes re.
שיט m. Remus: אני־שיט Navis remi, id est, impulsa remis, Jesa.33.21.
משיטים m.p. Remi: משוטיך Remos tuos, Ezech.27.6. Rabbini dicunt משוטו [?] ut Jon.1.13. in Aben Esra & Kimchi.
שוט Declinare: Particip. שט Declinans: Plur. Constr. ושטי כזב Et declinantes ad mendacium, Psalm.40.5.
שוך Sepivit, Obsepivit: Praeter. שכת בעדו Sepivisti circa eum, Job.1.10. Part. שך את־דרכך Obsepio viam tuam, Hos.2.6. Pih. Futur. תשככני vide in סכך.
שוך m. Sepes: Aff. שכו Sepem suam, Thren.2.6. cum Dagesch loco vocalis longae: vel est a סכך: Vide illic.
שוכה f. Ramus, à Sepimentis, quibus adhibetur: Constr. שוכת עצים Ramos arborum, Jud.9.48. Aff. שוכה Ramum suum,

page.notes: Hebrew points are largely not legible on the scan; consonants are given as printed, vowel points omitted. Doubtful readings marked [?]: שאטים (Kimchi's form), משוטו (Jon.1.13). The Hebrew headword forms (שוט, שט, שיט, שוך, שוכה) follow the printed heads. Long s rendered as plain s throughout (Jef = Jes, Jesa = Jesa, Casligavit = Castigavit, vers. = vers., fcuticis = scuticis). Entry at the foot continues on the next page.
